༄༅/ /gso sbyong rang gis blang ba'i cho ga bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gso sbyong rang gis blang ba'i cho ga bzhugs/

na mo shākya mu na ye/ na mo lo ka nā tha ya/ swasti pra dza bh+yaḥ gso sbyong rang gis blang ba'i cho ga ni/ nam langs pa'i mtshams su/ kha dang lag pa bkru ba sogs gtsang sbra dang ldan pas/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan la sogs pa'i drung du/ ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa zhig bshams/ dkon mchog la mos gus dang*/ las 'bras la yid ches dang*/ chos kyi phan yon yid la bsam ste/ rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyi 'gro la mchog tu gzigs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las bsgrub mdzad pa'i/ /dus gsum bla ma 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ /bdud sde dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing*/ /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa/ khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*/ /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams sgrol ba'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /phyogs dus kun khyab skyabs gsum bka' bsdod bcas// nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas/ /dpag med zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gsol/ /sems can rnams la brtse ba can/ /phrad dang bral ba'i dgongs pa can/ /mi 'bral bde ba'i dgongs pa can/ /phan bde dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /thub pas sgrib kun nges par grol/ /'jig rten thams cad zil gyis gnon/ khyod kyi mkhyen pas shes bya khyab/ /thugs grol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs ma lus thams cad 'dul/

/nyon mongs 'joms mdzad nyon mongs la/ /brtse bcas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhun gyis grub cing chags mi mnga'/ /thogs pa mi mnga' rtag par ni/ /mnyam par bzhag cing 'dri kun gyi/ /lan ldon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten dang brten pa bshad bya dang*/ /gsung dang mkhyen pa 'chad byed la/ / blo gros rtag thogs mi mnga' ba/ /legs ston khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gshegs nas spyod pa mkhyen mdzad de/ /de dag skad kyis sems can gyi/ /'ong dang 'gro dang nges 'byung la/ /legs 'doms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lus can rnams kyis khyod mthong na/ /skyes bu dam pa legs par 'tshal/ /mthong ba tsam gyis rab dang bar/ /mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /len dang gnas dang gtong ba dang*/ /sprul dang yongs su bsgyur ba dang*/ /ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes la/ /mnga' brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang*/ /theg chen nges par 'byung ba la/ /sems can rnams ni rab bslu ba'i/ / bdud 'joms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gzhan don du ye shes dang*/ / spangs dang dge 'byung gegs byed rnams/ /ston mdzad mu stegs gzhan dag gis/ /mi brdzi khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsrung med bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba/ / 'khor gyi nang na bag brgyad gsungs/ /kun nas nyon mongs gnyis spangs pa/ / 'khor sdud khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun mkhyen khyod la rgyu ba dang*/ /gnas pa kun la rtag par ni/ /kun mkhyen min spyod mi mnga' ba/ /yang dag don ldan khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sems can kun gyi bya ba la/ khyod ni dus las mi 'da' bas/ /mdzad pa rtag tu don mnga' ba/ /mi bsnyel khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'jig rten kun la nyin mtshan du/ /lan drug tu ni so sor gzigs/ /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i/ /phan dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyod pa dang ni rtog pa dang*/ /ye shes dang ni 'phrin las kyi/ /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas kun gyi/ /bla ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/

/sku gsum dag gi byang chub che/ /rnam pa kun brnyes thams cad du/ /sems can kun gyi the tshom dag /gcod pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dzin pa mi mnga' nyes mi mnga'/ /rnyog pa med cing mi gnas pa/ / mi g.yo chos rnams thams cad la/ /spros med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las grol zhing*/ /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing*/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs rnyed kyi/ /lus btud pa yi rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin dus gsum rgyal ba yi/ /'phrin las sgrub cing yon tan rnam g.yer med/ /bskal pa mnyam pa'i gdul bya smin mdzad pa'i/ /mnyam med bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /bskal ba grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags shing*/ / bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi 'dul mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan seng ge de la= / gang zhig 'byung po kun la thugs brtse bas/ /sngon chad ma thos chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /skyob pa lha dang mi rnams 'dul mdzad pa/ /srid pa mthar phyin de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba/ /ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra/ /grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lham me ba/ / mgon po mchog brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang tshe thub chen zhing pa'i grong bzhud tshe/ /'jam bu'i grib mas sku lus ma btang zhing*/ /lha bu gzhon nu drug gis btud gyur pa/ /de tshe mchod 'os khyod la= /mi mchog 'dul ba kha lo bsgyur mdzad cing*/

/kun spyod 'ching ba gcod mdzad de bzhin gshegs/ / dbang po zhi zhing nyer zhi zhi la mkhas/ /mnyan yod bzhugs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob/ /'khor ba 'jigs dang gser thub 'od srung dang*/ /shākya thub pa go tam lha yi lha/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthun pa'i dge tshogs smon lam rmad byung zhing*/ /spyad pa spyod tshe na yang mched gyur la/ /bskal bzang gcig la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon tshe byang chub chen por thugs bskyed nas/ /tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs dgongs pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa drug khri lnga stong la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan legs rin chen gser bzang mya ngan med/ /chos bsgrags mngon mkhyen sman bla shākya thub/ /rgya chen smon lam yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa brgyad la phyag= /rdo rje 'chang dbang rgyal ba rtag pa dang*/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje nyi ma dang*/ /pad+ma gar dbang rta yi rgyal po sogs/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga de bzhin gshegs yum bzhi/ /sems dpa' che dang khro bo'i dbang po rnams/ /rang rang rigs kyi lha mor bcas la sogs/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje phag mo bdag med sna tshogs yum/ /ye shes dbang mo rdo rje ro langs ma/ /rdor dbyings dbang phyug la sogs dkyil 'khor gyi/ /'khor los bsgyur ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dus pa bde dgyes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang*/ /gdan bzhi mā ya thod pa gshin rje'i gshed/ /dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs sngags rgyud kyi/ /ye shes lha tshogs kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gsang sngags rigs sngags gzungs sngags snying po dang*/ /phyag rgya'i rigs byung la sogs sngags kyi lha/ /zhi khro lha tshogs rgyud sde bzhi po las/

/gang gsungs rnams la gus pas phyag bgyi'o/ /phyag stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po stong*/ /spyan stong bskal ba bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong*/ /gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa'i/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi thugs kyi sras/ /gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin rgyal sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor mtha' dag 'joms mdzad pa/ /mkhyen brtse'i rang bzhin de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na/ /gsang sngags rigs sngags kun gyi bdag po ste/ /log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /phyag na rdo rje bsnams la= /'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal/ /mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams chen me yis zhe sdang bud shing sreg /ye shes 'od kyis ma rig mun pa sel/ /chos kyi rgyal tshab 'gro ba'i mgon mdzad pa/ /dga' ldan bzhugs pa de la= /dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog / zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku/ /ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /seng ge glang chen me sbrul choms rkun dang*/ /lcags sgrog rgya mtsho sha za'i 'jigs pa rnams/ / zhi mdzad zla ba'i 'od ltar mdzes pa'i sku/ /bcom ldan sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku yi skyon spangs mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ / gsung gi skyon spangs ka la piṅka'i dbyangs/ /thugs kyi skyon spangs shes bya mtha' dag mkhyen/ /bkra shis dpal 'bar ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang*/ /'jigs pa kun las rab tu skyob mdzad cing*/

/dri med bde chen nye bar sgrol mdzad pa'i/ /lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi/ /cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul ba sha wā rī/ /lha mo gang gi sgrub pa'i nad gdon bgegs/ /kun tu zhi mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gsung rab rgya mtsho yi/ /rnam par 'phrul ba'i dpal las legs byung zhing*/ /sgrub pa po la blo gros mchog ster ba/ /lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi 'khrugs pa dang snang mdzad spyan ras gzigs/ /rin chen 'od 'phro ri rab mu khyud dang*/ /'od dpag med dang rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /mthu stobs chen po brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje can/ /don yod zhags pa khro rgyal rta mchog dang*/ / ral gcig ma dang khro gnyer can ma ste/ /'phags pa lha lnga'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam rgyal 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag /mi g.yo 'dod pa'i rgyal po dbyug sngon can/ /stobs po che dang lha yi bu gnyis po/ /rnam rgyal lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs/ /sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel/ /nam mkha'i snying po byams pa kun tu bzang*/ /nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /so sor 'brang ma stong chen rab 'joms dang*/ /rma bya chen mo gsang sngags rjes 'dzin dang*/ / bsil ba'i tshal dang gtsug tor gdugs dkar sogs/ /'phrin las lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes ha ya gṝ ba rta mchog dpal/ /'bar ba'i sku la ral pa gyen du brdzes/ /ma rig tshangs pa kha bub gnon pa'i lha/ /pad+ma rigs sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin in+d+ra nī la'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs zung brjid pa'i sku/ /ye shes ral gri rdo rje zhags pa bsnams/ khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes rgyal ba'i rigs kyi sprul pa ni/

/lha min 'joms shing bdud kyi klud pa 'gems/ / sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gshin rje'i gshed/ /'od chen khro bo'i rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthu stobs thogs med rdo rje rnam par 'joms/ /'phrin las lhun grub bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sogs/ khro bo mngag gzhug tho ha'i dbang po rnams/ / rig pa'i tshogs dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur dang mthar byed bzhi/ /stobs chen mi g.yo 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang*/ /dbyug sngon hūṃ mdzad gnod mdzes rgyal po ste/ /phyogs bcu'i khro rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rlabs chen spyod pa'i tshul ni rab bzung nas/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad gyur pa/ /rab dga' la sogs sa la bzhugs pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzang skyong zla 'od gzhon nu yul 'khor skyong*/ /don zab dgongs 'grel kun 'dri chos 'phags dang*/ /blo gros ngag yangs don dam yang dag bzhugs/ /yon tan 'byung gnas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub pa'i bka' 'khor shwa ri'i bu dang ni/ /mau 'gal bu dang kun shes nor sbyin 'dzin/ /nye ba 'khor dang ma 'gags rab 'byor sogs/ /dgra bcom grangs la 'das la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong la sogs/ /dgra bcom rigs gyur skyes bu zung bzhi dang*/ /tshogs na spyod dang bse ru lta bu yi/ /'phags pa rang rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pas bstan pa yongs gtad 'od srung che/ /kun dga' bo dang sha na'i gos can dang*/ /nyer sbas dhi ti ka dang nag po dang*/ /legs mthong rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i rnal 'byor la brtson pas/ /tshe gcig phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes/ /in+d+ra bhu ti sa ra ha la sogs/ /dpag yas grub chen rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po klu sgrub ār+ya de wa dang*/ / thogs med dbyig gnyen phyogs glang chos kyi grags/ /chos spyod yon tan 'od dang dpa' bo sogs/

/'dzam gling rgyan mchog rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdom brtson dam pa dpal ldan zhi ba mtsho/ /brtul zhugs grub pa pad+ma 'byung gnas dpal/ /blo gsal dbang po pad+ma'i ngang tshul sogs/ /snyigs dus rgyal ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi yi dbang po chos bzhin sa skyong ba/ /rnam dpyod blo can des pas 'gro ba 'dul/ /dpa' mdzangs blon po'i tshogs kyi yongs bskor ba'i/ /rgyal blon byang sems rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i ring lugs bla na med/ /zhu chen bsgyur byed mchan bu'i gnas 'dug pa'i/ /skad gnyis smra ba blo gros gsal ldan pa/ /lo tsā chen po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'dzam bu'i gling du bstan pa'i srog shing btsugs/ kha ba can du chos kyi sgron me spar/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa shākya'i sras gcig pu/ /mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos rgyal tshul 'dzin cing*/ /gangs can khrod 'dir gdul bya ma lus par/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad pa yis/ khri srong lde btsan zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhyen pa rgyas/ /sgrol mas lung bstan kha ba can du byon/ /lnga brgya'i dus su thams cad mkhyen par gyur/ /'gro mgon a ti sha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa shākya shrī/ /rgya gar bod dang kha che la sogs pa/ /sna tshogs yul du dam chos rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /paṇa chen yab sras rnams la phyag 'tshal

lo/ /gzungs sngags rtog pa bya rgyud spyod rgyud dang*/ /rnal 'byor rgyud dang rnal 'byor bla med kyis/ /dbang lung bshad pa lag len man ngag gi /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /so thar byang sems gsang sngags sdom pa dang*/ /'dul ba mngon pa mdo sde rin po che/ /legs par bsrungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel gyi/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro la phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /bde gshegs bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*/ /'dzin dang spel dang bsrung dang rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /skyes bu dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba'i thugs rje yis/ / sgrub pa po la ma yengs bu bzhin skyong*/ / gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi 'phrul dang mngon par mkhyen pa'i dpal/ /nye bar dgongs nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs skyong ba'i/ /rdo rje chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*/ /gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzam+bha lha/ /dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs phyogs skyong bcu/ /rgyal chen bzhi sogs gtsang rigs mgon po ste/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /bskal ba grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags shing*/ /bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi 'dul mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan seng ge de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung bstan tshigs su bcad/ /ched brjod gleng gzhi rtogs brjod de lta byung*/ / skyes rabs rgyas dang rmad byung gtan la dbab/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal/ /bkra shis 'byung dang byang chub chen po dang*/

/chos 'khor cho 'phrul chen po lha las babs/ /dben sdum sku tshe'i 'du byed byin gyis brlabs/ /myang 'das mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ /skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che/ /'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che/ /bla med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*/ /rjes su yid rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ / mchod pa rnams/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yāḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ zhes pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ bsdu na yid kyi byin rlabs kyis kyang chog / mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla re dang*/ /mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkrams byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ / de bzhin du mchod yon ces pa'i gnas su gzhan rnams kyang sbyor te/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog /zhal zas/ sil snyan rnams 'jug /de rjes su bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya/ de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsdus pa blang bar bya ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la zhes sogs tshar gsum/ de rnams sngon 'gro'i rim pa yin no/ / dngos gzhi ni 'di skad ces/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rta cang shes lta bu/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas shing*/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i bka'/

legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can de dag gis/ sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang*/ phan par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ gso sbyong yang dag par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzungs te/ ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du gso sbyong yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o/ / deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing*/ /gzhan gyi nor yang blang mi bya/ /'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyad cing*/ /brdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o/ /skyon ni mang po nyer brten pa'i/ /chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ khri gdan che mtho mi bya zhing*/ /de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas/ /dri dang phreng ba rgyan dang ni/ /gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya/ /ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni/ /srog gcod la sogs mi byed ltar/ /de bzhin srog gcod la sogs spangs/ /bla med byang chub gnas thob shog /sdug bsngal mang dkrugs 'jig rten 'di/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog / ces lan gsum mo/ /de ni dngos gzhi'i bya ba yin la/ rjes ni/ tshul khrims yongs dag gi gzungs bzla zhing*/ smon lam 'debs pa yin te/ oṃ a mo gha/ shi la/ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ mahā shung+ngha satwa pasma bi bhu ṣi ta/ bhu dza dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta a wa lo ki te hūṃ phaṭa/ brgya rtsa'am/ ma 'grub na nyer gcig tsam bya/ khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing sogs sho lo ka gcig dang*/ rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su slob gyur te/ / bzang po spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing*/ /tshul khrims spyod pa dri med yongs dag pa/ /rtag tu ma nyams skyon med spyod par shog

/ji ltar nod pa'i bslab pa phra mo yang*/ /nges 'byung bsam pas byang chub ma thob bar/ /srog gi phyir yang gtong bar mi byed pa'i/ /thar pa'i rgyal mtshan rtag tu 'dzin par shog/sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims bsrung ba dang*/ /bzod pa sgom zhing brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*/ /mnyam par 'jog cing gnas lugs rtogs pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bsod nams 'di yi thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas nas/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrug pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /dge ba 'di yi skye bo kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ /bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ /dam pa gnyis po thob par shog /sems can bde dang ldan gyur cing*/ /sdug bsngal kun las thar par shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*/ /chos nyid mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog / gzhan yang ji ltar 'os pa'i smon lam gdab bo/ /bsnyen gnas kyi cho ga la nyan thos lugs dang*/ theg chen lugs gnyis yod pa las/ 'di ni theg chen gyi lugs/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i gzungs las 'byung ba yin no/ /'di dus dang por slob dpon las lan gcig blangs te/ phyis rang nam 'dod pa'i tshe/ rang gis blangs pas chog pa yin te/ dam bca' brtan pa'i phyir dus nges pa can du blangs na bzang bar bzhed do/ /gso sbyong rang gis blang ba'i lag len mdo tsam 'di yang*/ shes ldan rnams kyi nan tan du bsgrub pa'i 'os so/ /zhes pa'ang sa la spyod pa'i dbang phyug kun dga' rab brtan dbang gi rgyal po'i gsung gis bskul nas kun dga' snying pos bris pa'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/gso sbyong rang gis blang ba'i cho ga bzhugs/
